property_summary: For any owner and any incoming funds, when the Owner calls withdraw() the reference contract always reduces address(c).balance to zero (transfer reverts on recipient failure), whereas the mutant that uses Owner.call and ignores the returned success can leave funds in the contract if the Owner's receive/fallback reverts, violating the zero-balance rule for some inputs.
change_summary: Replace transfer with a low-level call to Owner, forwarding all gas and not reverting on failure (behavior differs if transfer would have failed).
